findings: Engagement is frozen: save_batch skips stored post ids, so a post's upvotes and comments are never re-read; every velocity is a cluster-sum delta driven by membership churn, not engagement growth

Engagement units are mixed and partly invented: Reddit/HN/Mastodon scores, Google Trends traffic bands or a default 200, Google News constant 300, Bluesky constant 200, YouTube views/1000 with likes stored as comments

Reddit is read through third-party mirrors chosen to avoid OAuth, and YouTube through yt-dlp because the trending page blocks automated clients: authentication and bot-defence circumvention ECDEV never adopts
Market targeting is a deny-list of nationality and language keywords
The predictor shows an uncalibrated weighted heuristic as a probability, with static spread-path and peak-time tables presented as forecasts; new clusters receive an invented 10-100% growth
The scorer omits emotion and score_breakdown keys, so emotion alerts never fire and the breakdown chart never renders
